## This nbdev project hosts the code for AAAI submission 13339.

### See `nbs` directory for code!

This project uses the Jupyter notebook environment. If you want to run
the code, you can spin up what you need by looking at the `Dockerfile`
in `.devcontainer`. The required packages are listed in
`requirements.txt`

Alternatively, the notebooks preserve their outputs.

All the code for the project is available in `nbs` directory. It is
organized by the steps taken in the methodology and available for both
datasets.

All the models/tensors used in the notebooks are available in the
`saved_weights` directory.

All the figures produced in the paper and the raw MNIST accuracies are
available in the `figures` directory and were produced by the notebooks
presented here.

This project also makes use of the nbdev library but that is
*optional!*. If you would like to view this project as a website with
`nbdev`, install the library and then run `nbdev_preview`.
